name: account_deactivate_confirm

metadata.description: Account deactivation confirmation containing the fully resolved link to the deactivation confirmation page.
notes: `user` is a dict (user.to_dict('basic')) auto-injected by User.send_template_email if missing.

`token_url` points at this deployment's OWN confirmation landing page (BASE_URL + the framework's landing route, #3257), then may be shortened. It is NOT the frontend WEBAPP_BASE_URL/WEBAPP_AUTH_PATH URL — that page is served by the API, and opening it changes nothing until the person confirms.
The deactivation token expires in 15 minutes and is single-use.

text_template:
Hello{% if user.display_name %} {{ user.display_name }}{% endif %},

A request was made to deactivate your account.

Open this secure link only if you want to continue:
{{ token_url }}

You will be asked to confirm on the page that opens. Nothing is closed until you do.

This link expires in 15 minutes. If you did not request deactivation, ignore this email and your account will remain active.
html_template:
Confirm account deactivation

Hello{% if user.display_name %} {{ user.display_name }}{% endif %},

A request was made to deactivate your account. This action may remove access to your data. You will be asked to confirm on the page that opens. Nothing is closed until you do.

Continue to deactivation

If the button does not work, copy and paste this link into your browser:

{{ token_url }}

This link expires in 15 minutes. If you did not request deactivation, ignore this email and your account will remain active.

Sent by Django-MOJO
